provenance_note: AI-assisted diplomatic transcription against the Steffel 1809 facsimile for RHD-FR-021, second low-confidence cohort. Facsimile authoritative; preserved OCR remains untouched. Independent human/philological and linguistic verification remains pending.
title: RHD-FR-021 diplomatic transcription B
transcription_scope: Complete accepted RHD-FR-021 articles, records 10–17 of 41

records.article_diplomatic: Geiß, Cambelátſchi, mit dem Beyſatze: mukíla, denn wenn es den Bock andeuten ſoll, wird hoguíla zugeſetzt.
records.uncertainty_note: Exact consonant sequence and accentuation in `Cambelátſchi`, `mukíla` and `hoguíla` remain pending independent collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Großvater, Cotto. Von Seiten des Vaters, Taré'a. Von Seiten der Mutter, Suilá.
records.uncertainty_note: The exact apostrophe/diacritic sequence in `Taré'a` and accentuation of `Suilá` remain pending independent collation.
The medial consonant cluster in the Rarámuri form is visually difficult; `Tichárje` is provisional pending independent collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Haus, Bechteke. Geh nach Haus, Beccù, oder cúl.mi.
records.uncertainty_note: The final alternative form is printed compactly and is provisionally read `cúl.mi`; punctuation and exact glyph sequence require independent collation.
